The structure of Ca8Nb2Cu6Se16 (reduced formula Ca4NbCu3Se8) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4/mmm (No. 143), with 32 atoms per unit cell distributed over 7 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cu centers with two Se neighbors and Nb centers in octahedral coordination by six Se atoms, while Ca centers display 10- and 14-neighbor environments. The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and fully connected across all 32 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner and edge sharing between Nb octahedra, and corner, edge, and face sharing among Ca 10- and 14-vertex polyhedra.
